about: Pre-push test selection data, read by packages/aethyme/scripts/prepush-selection.sh. modules: summed test seconds per (test binary, top-level test module) from Aethyme Gates' full-suite JUnit; refresh with .github/scripts/refresh-prepush-tests.py. always: run on every pre-push; whole binaries plus the modules with the most distinct failing CI runs per second of test time (2026-09-10..2026-11-08, failing_runs gives the count).
